t2286.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Saʿīd ibn al-Ḥakam ibn Muḥammad ibn Sālim ibn Abī Maryam al-Jumaḥī, known as Abū Muḥammad al-Miṣrī, as trustworthy, firm, and a jurist, of the leading tenth generation. He died in the year 24 at the age of eighty.
as: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
عن من اكتب بمصر؟ فقال: عن ابن أبي مريم
Asked from whom he should write hadith in Egypt, Aḥmad recommended Ibn Abī Maryam.
In my judgment Ibn Abī Maryam is an authority whose reports stand as proof.
وكان عاقلا، لم أر بمصر أعقل منه ومن عبد الله بن عبد الحكيم
He was sensible. I saw no one in Egypt more sensible than him and ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥakīm.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī

t2545.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Sulaymān b. Ḥarb al-Azdī al-Wāshiḥī al-Baṣrī, judge of Mecca, as trustworthy, a leader and memorizer, of the ninth generation, who died in 224 at the age of eighty.
as: أبو حاتم الرازي, quoted by al-Mizzī
سليمان بن حرب إمام من الأئمة كان لا يدلس، ويتكلم في الرجال وفي الفقه وليس بدون عفان ولعله أكبر منه
Sulaymān was a leading scholar, did not practice tadlīs, and spoke on transmitters and jurisprudence. He was at least equal to ʿAffān and perhaps greater.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان سليمان بن حرب قل من يرضى من المشايخ، فإذا رأيته قد روى عن شيخ فاعلم أنه ثقة.
Sulaymān approved of few teachers, so when he transmitted from one, that teacher was trustworthy.
يحيى بن أكثم, quoted by al-Mizzī
هو ثقة حافظ للحديث عاقل في نهاية الستر والصيانة
He is trustworthy, a master of hadith in memory, sensible, discreet, and scrupulous.
كان سليمان بن حرب يحدث بحديث ثم يحدث به كأنه ليس ذاك.
Sulaymān would relate a hadith and then relate it again as though it were a different report.
الحافظ أبو بكر, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان سليمان يروي الحديث على المعنى فتتغير ألفاظه في روايته.
Sulaymān transmitted the meaning of reports, so the wording varied in his retelling.
يعقوب بن شيبة السدوسي, quoted by al-Mizzī
حدثنا سليمان بن حرب، وكان ثقة ثبتا، صاحب حفظ.
Sulaymān narrated to us, and he was trustworthy, firmly reliable and had a strong memory.
He was trustworthy and transmitted many hadiths.
He was trustworthy and prolific in hadith.

t2703.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Sallām ibn Sulaym al-Ḥanafī, Abū al-Aḥwaṣ al-Kūfī, as trustworthy, precise, and a man of hadith, of the seventh generation, who died in 79.
as: Trustworthy, precise, a man of hadith.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū al-Aḥwaṣ is more precise than Sharīk.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yaḥyā says Abū al-Aḥwaṣ and Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh are close.
He was reliable and adhered to the Sunnah.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He transmitted many hadiths and was sound in the field.

وشهدت غسل ابنة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وحكت ذلك فأتقنت. وحديثها أصل في غسل الميت
She was present at the washing of the Prophet’s daughter and described it accurately. Her hadith is a basis for washing the dead.
